stemMd: A permit requires either a survey or an exemption, possibly both. A permit was issued in compliance with this rule and no exemption existed. What must have existed?

options.label: D
options.textMd: A refusal instead of a permit

explanationMd: Permit issuance requires at least one of survey and exemption. With the exemption ruled out, the survey must be present. Allowing both does not alter this inference when one alternative is false.

distractorRationale.a: This contradicts the lack of an exemption.
distractorRationale.e: That would fail the stated requirement.
